{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is negative or neutral).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment history shows persistent negative signals (e.g., -0.20 or -0.25) over recent days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-10 day average, reduce by 5-15% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment shifts from positive to negative (e.g., 0.00 → -0.20 or -0.25).",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term volatility: if true outcome deviates >10% from forecast, re-calibrate next period’s forecast toward historical mean.",
    "For horizon >15 days, reduce forecast volatility if sentiment remains flat or negative — model should not over-anticipate recovery.",
    "When sentiment is positive (0.00 or above), allow slight upward bias but cap at 5% above recent 7-day average to avoid overcorrection."
  ]
}
